title: Around the wall
notes: A 2-wheel lock starts at 00 and must never show 01, 11 or 21: a wall across the second wheel’s 1. The obvious way to 02, through 01, is barred, so BFS goes round the wall: 00 → 90 → 91 → 92 → 02, 4 moves. 17 states leave the queue and make 65 moves; 30 states are visited. With no visited set it takes 34 sequences and 133 moves.
